name: Docmost
short_description: Open-source collaborative wiki and documentation platform.
description: Docmost is an open-source collaborative wiki and documentation platform. Write with a powerful rich-text editor, organize content in spaces and pages, collaborate in real-time, manage permissions per workspace, and attach files and images to documents.
usecases: Build a team wiki with collaborative real-time editing.
Organize project documentation in structured spaces and pages.
Manage permissions and access control per workspace or page.
